messages.author: 645e2b041ea2a63e
messages.subject: Re: Intercepts estimate using bcfa()
parts:
Lang,

Try adding the argument meanstructure = TRUE to your bcfa() command. Some models only require a sample covariance matrix (without a need to estimate intercepts), and this speeds up model estimation. So we only estimate the intercepts when they are needed (or when the user requests it).

Ed
